trigger: Plays upon entering the historical soundstage district.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Abandoned Soundstages. Once the cradle of cinema, now bleached in chroma-key green.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Look at this sacred place! They tore down practical sets for flat green voids!

lines.speaker: manvi
lines.text: Hawwww! Where did all the vintage Bollywood drama go? It's emotionally vacant!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, practical sets don't scale. But this vibe? Zero saturation. Pure beige.

lines.speaker: sehaj
lines.text: Not quiet. Mansukh is blasting music in Stage 2. Vajj.
